name: Moving-average crossover
idea: A signal when a fast moving average crosses a slow one on a closed bar; optionally only when the close is on the same side of a slower trend average.

params.label: Average type
params.help: How both averages (and the trend average) are calculated.

params.label: Slow average
params.help: Bars in the slow average: more than the fast one.

params.label: Trend filter
params.help: Only signal when the close is on the same side of a slower trend average.

params.label: Trend average
params.help: Bars in the trend average: more than the slow one.

params.label: The idea is wrong beyond
params.help: The level that says the idea is wrong: the latest confirmed swing, or the slow average. When it is not on the losing side of the close, there is no signal.

params.label: Swing size
params.help: Which swings count: 0 is the smallest, 3 the largest. Larger swings need more history.

constraints.message: The fast average must have fewer bars than the slow one.
The trend average must have more bars than the slow one.
